result.topic_en: Calculations on the axisymmetric Laplace (heat) equation in cylindrical coordinates: separating with sin(μx) yields the modified Bessel equation, whose solutions are expressed as integrals f(q), φ(q) with series and asymptotic expansions, Riemann P-function forms, and Fourier sine integrals for the boundary derivative at r=c.

methods.what: Separation of variables in axisymmetric Laplace equation giving modified Bessel equation
Power series solution with recurrence for coefficients
Integral representations of the two Bessel-type solutions (K0, I0 type)
Series expansions of f and φ
Fourier sine integral solution of boundary value problem
Riccati transformation of the Bessel equation via logarithmic derivative
Gamma-function integrals (Euler) and sine transform of power
